provenance.meaning: a deleted App: every App-JWT endpoint answers 404 Integration not found
provenance.method: curl with an RS256 App JWT signed by a throwaway 2048-bit key generated for the probe (registered to no App); status, headers and body recorded verbatim
provenance.request: POST /app/installations/1/access_tokens with a JWT whose iss names no App (the same 404 body came back for GET /repos/Falconiere/toolu-ghrunner/installation and GET /app/installations)
provenance.sanitization: none needed: the reply carries no credential
